C1807.title: Unitree Go1 Robot Dog CloudSail Pre-installed Backdoor (CVE-2025-2894)
C1807.summary: In March 2025, researchers disclosed an undocumented backdoor (CVE-2025-2894) in the Unitree Go1 consumer quadruped. The Oray CloudSail remote-access service started on the onboard Raspberry Pi and established a P2P tunnel that bypassed NAT, potentially allowing holders of the relevant API key to control devices remotely. The vendor later revoked related API tokens, but public material did not show that the backdoor function was fully patched. The flaw is classified as CWE-912 hidden functionality.
